title: Fix site scoped contextinfo
summary: SharePoint request-digest calls now correctly target site-scoped URLs instead of tenant root for operations like CreateList, CreateListItem, CreateFolder, and UpdateListItemMetaDataField.
key_points: Request-digest acquisition now uses site-base URL accessor instead of hostname-only for proper site scoping
GetHost() method remains unchanged to preserve behavior for hostname-only consumers
Added regression tests to verify contextinfo requests retain the configured /sites/<site> path
Fixes site-scoped SharePoint URL targeting issue that was incorrectly routing to tenant root
No breaking changes to public APIs or schema
